integrity: All two- and three-pair profiles are exhaustively enumerated with two independent blocking-pair stability tests and exact integer objective comparisons. The four-pair witness is checked against all twenty-four perfect matchings.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is restricted to complete strict bipartite stable-marriage instances through three pairs, together with one sharp four-pair conflict witness. Ties, incomplete lists, roommates, many-to-one markets, and larger-market classifications are outside scope.
title: Sharp coincidence boundary for egalitarian and minimum-regret stable marriage
